description: Read one saved memory entry in full, by its 1-based index. The index is the one memory_search returns, or /memories lists. Returns a bounded excerpt with truncation and continuation info: when truncated, re-call with start_char set to next_start_char for the rest. Use it to pull only the needed entry instead of re-searching.
name: memory_get

index.description: 1-based entry number, as returned by memory_search or /memories.

max_chars.description: Max characters in the excerpt. Default 2000, max 8000.

start_char.description: Character offset to start the excerpt at. Default 0; use next_start_char to continue.

target.description: Which store holds the entry: 'memory' for personal notes, 'user' for user profile.
